title: Introduce staged validator for smart-routing DSL with incremental fallbacks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Refactor the policy engine's routing-rule validation path into a staged validator that enforces syntactic, semantic, and runtime-compatibility checks separately. Goal is to enable safe, incremental schema evolution for region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants without breaking existing customer configs. The validator will emit structured warnings for non-fatal incompatibilities and block only unsafe changes. This ticket delivers the validator core, migration helper, and the first compatibility rule set for regional affinity and fallback chains.
acceptance_criteria: Implement three-stage validator: parse -> semantic-typing -> runtime-safety checks
New validator runs as a pre-commit and as a runtime admission check behind a feature flag
Backward-compatibility mode emits non-blocking warnings for deprecated selectors
Migration helper tool can suggest minimal rewrites for tier and fallback variants
Unit and integration tests cover canonical examples and adversarial fuzz cases
Performance overhead <5% on policy load and <50ms p95 parsing latency for 1k rules
technical_notes: Parser: reuse existing PEG grammar but emit typed AST nodes instead of raw maps
Semantic typing: annotate selectors with inferred domains (region, tier, model_family, capacity_class)
Runtime-safety: ensure fallback chains terminate and that regional fallbacks respect data residency constraints
Validation levels: ERROR (block), WARN (non-blocking), INFO (advisory) with machine-readable codes
Migration helper: implement rule transforms + confidence score; keep human-readable changelog in suggestions
Schema evolution: support opt-in strict-mode that progressively tightens checks over N releases

rollout_plan: Feature-flag gated: 1) enable parsing+typing for all clusters in advisory mode, 2) enable WARN-level checks for internal tenants, 3) enable ERROR blocking for new policy creation only, 4) after 2 weeks of stable metrics enable blocking on updates, 5) enable full-blocking by default in runtime-1.20 release. Canary on dedicated-dev then 10% of production via traffic-split.
test_plan: Unit: grammar edge cases, typed AST invariants
Property: fuzzed selector inputs and ensure validator doesn't crash
Integration: load 10k synthetic rules and measure parse/validate latency
Migration: run helper on 50 real customer configs (anonymized) and verify suggested diffs
E2E: Console warning surface and 'apply suggestion' button flow with RBAC checks
Performance: ensure p95 parse+validate < 200ms for heavy rule sets
risks: False positives could block legitimate customer policies; mitigated via advisory phase and a clear rollback path
Parser changes might break rare DSL constructs; we keep old parser active behind compatibility flag during migration
Migration helper suggestions may be unsafe for highly-customized tenant rules; suggestions include confidence and require admin approval
Performance regression under large rule sets; will add sampling and lazy validation as fallback
